lines: #The alarm goes off. And the *negotiation* begins.
The lazy version of you *always* wins.
You deserve a break. You worked hard *yesterday.*
Training is at seven. Not *maybe* at seven.
Savings come out on payday. Not if there's *something* left.
The phone goes in the drawer at ten. No *debate.*
They decided once, and they stopped *arguing.*
So when the excuse shows up tomorrow, don't *answer* it.
Every time you keep it, the voice gets *quieter.*
end: Follow for your daily push at 7am & 7pm.

post.title: Stop Negotiating With Yourself
post.caption: Decide once. Then remove the choice. 🔥
post.first_comment: What's the negotiation you lose every morning? 👇
